Stara Zhadova Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Chernivtsi Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Stara Zhadova's Jewish community became independent in 1890 when Rabbi Israel Ginsburg arrived. On July 6, 1941, following the German-Romanian occupation, 543 Jews were forced to march to Storojineti — documented elsewhere in this collection — and locked in the synagogue there together with Jews from surrounding villages; many were later deported to the Edineti ghetto, the same destination documented at Hertsa elsewhere in this collection. That autumn, the community was gathered in Mogilev and expelled to various camps; only a few survived.
